text: …　もう　おわっちゃったのね

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says it happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is its casual short form. おわっちゃった = 'it went and ended'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end shows the speaker is taking in what happened; the だ is left off in women's speech. おわっちゃったのね = 'so it's over, isn't it'.
